GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 Wide 3 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # Wide trip

Began OK. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead Four Wide before worked to lead off rail by 2 Lengths early . Held lead off rail midrace & pushed to quicken & laid out 8W (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 300m & challenged @ 150m. Fought on in 2-horse go in last 100m & shaded late. # Worked/good effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was trapped four-wide without cover until near 600m. When qstd as to why, after clearing horses positioned to her inside passing the 600m, she had not brought her mount in closer to the rail to save ground, rider advised the track was becoming rain effected and the ground was expected to be superior to the outside of straight, she was instrc to make her run wider. Trainer confirmed instrc. Rdr was nevertheless told that she should have shifted her mount in to obtain a position closer to the rail, which would have saved ground may have enhanced her mounts finishing effort.
